# Warlock Queue

> Package: `@warlock.js/queue`

> Durable background jobs for Warlock.js on BullMQ + Redis: defineJob, dispatch with delay/priority, retries with backoff, progress, failed-job access, in-process workers with graceful shutdown.

## Skills

- [configure-queue](@warlock.js/queue/configure-queue/SKILL.md): Configure the queue in @warlock.js/queue; use when you need to configure queue.
- [define-jobs](@warlock.js/queue/define-jobs/SKILL.md): Define and dispatch jobs in @warlock.js/queue; use when you need to define jobs.
- [manage-failed-jobs](@warlock.js/queue/manage-failed-jobs/SKILL.md): Failed jobs in @warlock.js/queue; use when you need to manage failed jobs.
- [overview](@warlock.js/queue/overview/SKILL.md): @warlock.js/queue overview for orientation and choosing the focused skill for the task.
- [queue-notifications](@warlock.js/queue/queue-notifications/SKILL.md): Queue notifications with BullMQ in @warlock.js/queue; use when you need to queue notifications.
